title: Tideglass Quay Unveiling Platform
description: A bunting-draped platform stands above wet quay stones while fog curls around the crowd ropes. The ribbon has fallen, the guest of honor is gone, and the old chapel bell has only just stopped tolling.

placements.surface: wet wooden unveiling platform deck directly in front of the central lectern where the guest of honor had stood
placements.lighting: dim cool overcast light with small warm reflections from brass fittings and surrounding lanterns
placements.perspective: slight top-down view of the platform deck, so a small pocket object can rest flat on the horizontal boards
placements.reason: The cracked pocket compass physically belongs on the central platform surface at Venn's standing position and remains visible without covering the embedded clues.

placements.surface: wet foreground quay stones in front of the unveiling platform, clear of the player spawn area
placements.lighting: cool blue-grey rainy ambient light with warm amber spill from the quay lamps and small highlights reflected from wet stone
placements.perspective: side-on pixel-art scene with a slight top-down view of the quay paving and platform surfaces
placements.reason: Maribel can stand on the open visible floor near the official platform without blocking the speech-page or wax clue zones.

placements.surface: wet foreground quay stones near the right-hand press table and rope barrier
placements.lighting: cool harbor fog light mixed with warm amber edge light from the right lantern and reflections on the rain-slick ground

title: The Condemned Chapel Bell Tower
description: Inside the locked chapel tower, rotten stairs climb toward the silent bell. Salt air, dust, and municipal warning placards make the chamber feel abandoned, but several details look far too recent.

placements.surface: visible dusty stone floor at the right of the condemned placard and below the wall ladder
placements.lighting: mostly cool shadow with a faint warm spill from the left window catching edges of objects
placements.perspective: side-on tower interior with a slightly elevated view of the floor plane and vertical wall geometry
placements.reason: Edda fits naturally as caretaker beside the municipal warning signs on a clear patch of floor, facing back into the room and away from the right-edge transition.

placements.surface: clear dusty stone floor in front of the bell support posts and right side of the stair base
placements.lighting: dim warm light from the tall left window with cooler deep shadow toward the right side of the tower
placements.perspective: side-on painted scene with slight top-down visibility on the floor and upright stone walls; objects scale smaller toward the rear stairs
placements.reason: Jonah can stand on the open floor near the salvage chains and bell structure without blocking the player spawn area or the central clue footprints.

clueZones.label: Salt-wet rope knot
clueZones.surface: hanging bell rope beside the central rotten stair
clueZones.reason: The box tightly contains the large frayed knot and the darkened wet rope section hanging below it, visually distinct from the dusty dry wall and floor around it.

clueZones.label: Brass pulley filings
clueZones.surface: upper wooden beam and stair tread area beneath the bell mechanism
clueZones.reason: The box encloses the bright crescent gouge on the dusty beam and the nearby gold-colored flecks falling and collecting on the stair surface below.

clueZones.label: Diver boot prints
clueZones.surface: dusty stone chapel floor across the center foreground
clueZones.reason: The rectangle covers the visible trail of broad dark hobnailed footprints crossing the dust from left-center toward the lower right, with softened dusty edges.

placements.surface: visible wooden floorboards between the desk and the stacked civic file trunks

placements.perspective: side-on pixel-art street view with slight top-down visibility on the cobbles and vertical warehouse walls
placements.reason: This clear patch of visible cobbles places the retired diver near harbor cargo without blocking the lock clue, caster tracks, or player spawn points.

placements.surface: wet cobbled floor directly before the warehouse doors
placements.lighting: warm amber spill from the lantern over the warehouse door, mixed with cool fog-blue ambient light from the street arches
